title: Shark Attacks
text:
The Global Shark Attack File (GSAF) is a worldwide database of reported shark-human encounters. Its records help show where and under what circumstances these incidents occur, but they reflect reported cases rather than every encounter.
Shark encounters can be frightening, but fatal attacks are rare. Their prominence in news and popular culture can make the risk seem greater than it is; these records describe patterns, not an individual’s odds of an attack.
Explore the Map to compare reported attack counts by country, and the Trends page to compare fatal and non-fatal attacks across activities with at least 50 incidents. Unknown outcomes are left out of the Trends chart.
